init.title: Tariffs
init.description: Grid transfer tariffs are added on top of the energy price (SEK/kWh incl. VAT). Tariff mode sets the energy price: 'spot' = hourly Nordpool spot; 'monthly_average' = one flat price for every hour, the rolling average spot from the 1st of the month (or the fixed monthly average below when > 0). The price floor (0 = none) is the lowest energy price your contract charges. Export is always paid at hourly spot.

data.buy_price_monthly_avg_sek: Fixed monthly average (SEK/kWh, 0 = rolling average from the 1st)
